pairs.evidence: src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:93 the active sink starts as sentrySink and nothing swaps in noopSink when telemetry is off at boot (src/main.tsx:337 only skips Sentry init), so isSinkDelivering() is true, Sentry silently discards, and src/lib/analytics/activation.ts:141 burns the funnel latch undelivered; navigation also still ships per event (src/lib/analytics/index.ts:38, :43)

techniques.evidence: src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:93 composition starts on the live sink and only AccountSettings ever installs noopSink, so a telemetry-off boot is silence by accident (uninitialised Sentry), not the chosen null sink; contract also accepts raw per-event ingestion at src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:71

src/lib/analytics/activation.ts:138 the delivery latch keys on isSinkDelivering(), which reads sink identity; with telemetry off at boot it returns true, the conversion is dropped by an uninitialised Sentry, and :141 records it reported - a permanently missing funnel row, the exact failure the comment at :132 claims to prevent

src/lib/analytics/index.ts:38 every section visit (and :43 every tab switch) is sent as its own Sentry captureMessage beside the session summary; SessionSummary (src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:57) carries no window or vocabulary version and there is no checkpoint/recovered-session path

src/lib/analytics/navCatalog.ts:113 sections are a projection of the nav registry (:60, realized) but the tab-dimension axis is a hand list with no inventory gate, and it already omits kpisTab (src/stores/slices/system/uiSlice.ts:93), twinTab and obsidianBrainTab, which vanish from the ignored report
src/lib/analytics/index.ts:188 trackInteraction admits any category/action/label string with no registry or validation; callers already mix grammars (step_complete, create, filter_run, tab_open)

src/lib/analytics/index.ts:188 the free-form label field is admissible by type, and the only scrubber is the Sentry beforeSend denylist the sink names at src/lib/analytics/sink.ts:16 - scrubbing downstream by pattern, not allowlist at the source

pairs.registryProposal: Upward lesson for activation-and-funnel-honesty / sink-abstraction: a delivery latch that asks the composition `is the null sink installed?` is only honest if the null sink is ALSO what boot installs when consent is absent; here consent-off is enforced one layer down (destination never initialised) so the identity check reports delivering. The technique should state that the latch query and the opt-out mechanism must be the same switch. The react--activation-and-funnel-honesty application praises activation.ts and should be corrected with this case.
